name: Shinonome Akito
source:
Akito looks up to [url=/c128184]An[/url]'s father, and has been a musician since middle school. He sings with [url=/c128187]Touya[/url] at event houses under the group name BAD DOGS. At first glance, he appears to be an easy-going guy, but...

He's part of the street music group Vivid BAD SQUAD.

[From in-game profile]
